skills.name: consistent-ui
skills.description: Enforce UI consistency across an entire codebase, regardless of language, framework, or styling approach. Detects drift in spacing, typography, colors, components, iconography, and interaction patterns across every UI surface. Works for web (React, Vue, Svelte, Angular, Solid, plain HTML/CSS), native mobile (SwiftUI, Jetpack Compose, Flutter, React Native), and server-rendered templates (Blade, ERB, Twig, Razor, JSP, Pug, Liquid). Generates a consistency report with P0-P3 findings and a remediation plan, then optionally fixes drift in place. Use when the user mentions "consistency", "looks different on page X vs Y", "design drift", "unify styles", "audit components", or wants to align a codebase to its design system.
skills.description_zh: 审查代码库全部UI表面的间距、字体、颜色、组件、图标与交互一致性，支持网页、移动端及服务端模板，生成P0至P3问题报告和修复计划，并可按需原地修复。
